brief.summary_1line: Ayodhya falls into collective grief after Rama’s exile, with citizens lamenting, condemning Kaikeyi, and longing to follow Rama into the forest.

image_candidates.scene_text: Citizens of Ayodhya wander the road with raised arms and tearful faces, searching the vanished tracks of Rama’s chariot before collapsing in grief.
Inside darkened homes across Ayodhya, cold hearths and unadorned women sit weeping while families lament Rama’s absence.
Women of Ayodhya confront their returning husbands, pointing angrily while tears stream down their faces, blaming them for coming back without Rama.
